st_navigateurs.name: Place du Défilé
st_navigateurs.alt: A sunny cobbled quayside square beside a canal dock where an old two-masted sailing ship is moored, with swans on the water, a shop with a blue awning on the left, a wooden pier, stone stairs up a grassy bank, a lamp-lit promenade and a little stone bridge in the distance. Monsieur Verbe beats his drum at the head of a duck parade; puts a chef's hat on the hen in a gold beret; rides a tiny donkey; sends his toy robot off with the dog; waves a white flag to lead the ducklings past the swans; and baits his fishing hook with bread on a bollard. The far bridge leads back to the Carrefour des Voyages.

doors.label: Ruelle des Rebonds
doors.hint: Through the shop door under the blue awning

doors.label: Chemin des Vagabonds
doors.hint: Up the stairs on the far bank

doors.label: Allée de la Balade
doors.hint: Along the promenade by the water

rebonds.name: Ruelle des Rebonds
rebonds.alt: A little cobbled harbor lane behind a long stone wall, with an iron lamp post, a big tree with a squirrel, a patterned rug, a stack of fish crates and a wooden jetty over the water: Monsieur Verbe walks along the top of the wall beside a blue jay; crawls on the rug after his red ball; points at the squirrel with his dog; watches his yellow ball bounce off the lamp post in a green beret; prowls round the crates with a sly fox; and sneezes as his toy rocket fizzles. The old door on the left leads back to the square; the jetty leads to the quay.

doors.label: Place du Défilé
doors.hint: Back through the old door to the square

doors.label: Quai des Navigateurs
doors.hint: Along the jetty to the quay

navigateurs.name: Quai des Navigateurs
navigateurs.alt: A wide stone quay on the canal dock with an old sailing ship moored behind, a wooden jetty, a ring hanging from a post and a giant walnut-shell boat on the water: Monsieur Verbe jumps back from his sizzling frying pan; gasps into his hand mirror as the tower of bowls topples; pushes a giant pumpkin with his mirror in his pocket; charges with his long pole at the ring, mirror at his belt; waves the little boat in on the jetty; and looks through his telescope from the walnut shell. The stone stairs lead back to the square; the grassy path climbs to the headland.

doors.label: Place du Défilé
doors.hint: Back up the stone stairs to the square

vagabonds.name: Chemin des Vagabonds
vagabonds.alt: A grassy headland above the harbor, yellow with gorse, looking out over boats on the sea, with a bench, two cows, a ribbon finish line and an iron gate in a stone wall: Monsieur Verbe looks into his mirror as his cart of fondue pots wobbles; squeezes onto the bench between two fishermen in yellow coats; wriggles between the cows wearing toy feelers, mirror in hand; bursts through the ribbon waving a boot in a green beret; turns his map with a compass; and wanders in loops of footprints. The steps on the left lead back down; the iron gate leads to the promenade.

doors.label: Place du Défilé
doors.hint: Back down the steps to the square

doors.label: Allée de la Balade
doors.hint: Through the iron gate to the promenade

balade.name: Allée de la Balade
balade.alt: A sunny waterside promenade on the canal dock, with lamp posts, a big electric fan, a red carpet, a little wooden harbor crane, a brick harbor office and a filing cabinet: Monsieur Verbe's scarf flaps in front of the fan; he unrolls the red carpet for a kangaroo; strolls by the water while three ducks waddle along; cranks the crane to lift a crate of oranges; and finds a fish in the filing cabinet. The stone archway leads back to the square.

doors.label: Place du Défilé
doors.hint: Back through the stone archway to the square
